investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway (an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting /v1/agents) was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production-api layer received a 502 bad_gateway when attempting to POST to the swarm gateway during remote agent provisioning. This caused POST /api/agents to fail before any agent identity, VM ID, or remote state could be returned, leaving all required evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) absent. The identical error message across all three sibling checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) confirms a shared upstream dependency failure rather than a per-check code defect. No user-traffic or incident signals are present in the supplied evidence, so impact is scoped to this observability eval run.
